Ten meaning units: Greta runs for the council / her rival promises a road / the candidates debate in the inn / Greta canvasses door to door / the villagers put their ballots into a sealed box / a teacher guards the box / the council counts after sunset / the first count is a tie / the rival demands a recount / Greta keeps a lead of three votes. Subjects alternate between the protagonist (Greta), other people (rival, candidates, villagers, teacher), an institution (the council) and an event (the first count), singular and plural, so C3 switches cross real subject-verb agreement. No separable German verbs ('abstimmen', 'abgeben', 'auszählen', 'ankreuzen' avoided: 'legen ... in', 'zählt', 'ergibt', 'verlangt', 'behält'). 'Greta' is the only proper name; present tense and positive polarity throughout. Unit 9 reads naturally in German, units 1 and 10 in English.
